dialogue.user:
Thanks for the options! I’m leaning toward a chic sneaker, so I’m most interested in the Sam Edelman Women's Leya Fashion Sneaker and the Steve Madden Women's Gills Fashion Sneaker. 

Could you share what customers have said in their reviews for each of these? I’d love to hear some of the positive feedback, and maybe if there are any common complaints.
dialogue.agent:
Here’s what customers have shared in reviews:

For the **Sam Edelman Women's Leya Fashion Sneaker**:
- Positive: Reviewers love the playful, fluffy design, calling them “awesome, comfy, fun.” They’re described as good quality, chic, and comfortable with a cushy insole.
- Sizing is a common theme; several buyers recommend sizing down because the sneakers tend to run a bit large, with some heel slippage if you get your regular size.
- “Do not let the negative reviews discourage you from buying these. They are not cheaply made nor do they look it… gorgeous with all pom poms intact.”

For the **Steve Madden Women's Gills Fashion Sneaker**:
- Positive: People find these stylish and comfortable, especially for fall and winter. "Love them, look great" is a typical sentiment.
- Negative: Sizing runs inconsistent—some found their usual size too tight, while the next size up was too big.
- Those who got the right fit were pleased, saying the shoes fit well and look great.

Would you like more details about features or material, or help deciding between these two?

top_reviews.title: I call them Tribble Tennies
top_reviews.text:
Awesome, comfy, fun. (Always my buzzwords for shoe collecting). Friends thought the fluffy balls looked like baby Tribbles (Google original "Star Trek" series haha)
On a chilly day with a big sweater and jeans, slip these on and make yourself smile. Good quality. I go between 8.5-9 and sized down to 8.5. Sort of snug, but cushy insole and style make that work fine. Didn't want them too big and falling off (sole is thick and heavier)

top_reviews.title: These are so cute but SO HUGE. I'm in ...
top_reviews.text: These are so cute but SO HUGE. I'm in between an 8 and 8.5 normally and my heel was coming out of the 8. So much so that I'm not even sure if the 7.5 will be small enough! If in doubt at all between 2 sizes, ORDER DOWN.

top_reviews.title: Love these shoes!
top_reviews.text: These shoes are so flippin' cute! Do not let the negative reviews discourage you from buying these.  They are not cheaply made nor do they look it. I bought the grey suede and they are gorgeous with all pom poms in tact.  Hopefully they will stay that way and if not I will take them to a shoe repair shop - I love them that much.  I would caution going down a half size though. I always wear a size 9 in any shoe and these do slip in the back of the heel.  I debated sending them back for an 8.5 but I did not want to hassle with it and I can still wear them as is.  I'm wearing them now with skinny jeans and a Tshirt!

top_reviews.title: Four Stars
top_reviews.text: love these shoes!  comfortable and stylish.  they'll be great for Fall & Winter

top_reviews.title: Disappointed.
top_reviews.text: Very cute shoe, but sizing is off. The 10 was too tight and the the 11 way too big. Disappointed.

top_reviews.title: Love them, look great
top_reviews.text: Love them, look great. I took black with leather upper, usually wear US 5, took 5 as well, fit well.
